Good morning. Here is your daily brief for Wednesday 10 June 2026.

Walthamstow: 13°C, overcast, high 15° / low 10°, 100% chance of rain (expected 2pm–10pm).

GBP/USD 1.340 · GBP/ILS 3.947.

📈 B2B SaaS and go-to-market
- Sales is becoming less central to B2B company engines as AI-driven customer experiences mature, though the transition creates competitive pressure for traditional sales leaders charging customers one dollar per API call when Claude costs twenty to two hundred pounds monthly <https://www.saastr.com/sales-used-to-be-the-engine-for-the-ai-leaders-its-often-more-the-caboose/>
- Aurasell CEO Jason Eubanks revealed on stage at SaaStr AI 2026 that his previous company ran 22 tools requiring 11 operations people and costing three million dollars in annual fees, arguing the entire go-to-market stack model is collapsing <https://www.saastr.com/22-tools-3m-in-fees-11-ops-people-aurasells-case-for-killing-the-gtm-stack/>
- SaaStr itself now runs 20 plus AI agents with over five hundred thousand pounds invested in AI infrastructure, following a ninety ten rule of buying existing solutions before building custom ones, including their own AI VP of Marketing <https://www.saastr.com/we-vibe-coded-our-ai-vp-of-marketing-heres-what-it-actually-does/>
- So what for you: Your Monday.com and Israeli SaaS GTM playbooks are getting hammered by founders switching to Claude plus lightweight tooling instead of enterprise software—you need to reposition your advisory away from stack consolidation and toward unit economics and AI cost architecture.

🔬 Verified research
- Mathematician Terry Tao has become a leading evangelist for automated proof-checkers that decompose mathematical problems into small, independently solvable pieces that can be reassembled with complete confidence in correctness, signalling a new era in mathematical research <https://www.quantamagazine.org/how-terry-tao-became-an-evangelist-for-ai-in-math-20260608/>
- Physicists at University College Cork have developed a quantum witness technique revealing spinons in quantum spin liquid candidates, a long-sought state of quantum matter that behaves like a magnetic liquid and never freezes <https://phys.org/news/2026-06-quantum-witness-technique-reveals-spinons.html>
- Northwestern University engineers have discovered that water chemistry slows plastic degradation in natural environments, explaining why plastic products persist for decades to centuries in rivers, lakes and oceans even under direct sunlight <https://phys.org/news/2026-06-plastic-lingers-chemistry-nature-cleanup.html>
- So what for you: If you're advising B2B SaaS founders on go-to-market strategy, the shift toward AI-powered verification tools in complex domains signals growing enterprise demand for trust-enabling technologies that reduce manual validation costs.

🇬🇧 UK politics
- Andy Burnham, Greater Manchester mayor, said he would seek to enter any Labour leadership contest, but would need to win the Makerfield by-election first to be a viable candidate <https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cp9p9z31rr1o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss>
- Prime Minister Keir Starmer has hardened his position and told supporters he will fight any leadership contest after Burnham's announcement <https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c3vyxzl625po?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss>
- In Makerfield, a majority of voters say they would be less likely to vote for a candidate with offensive social media posts, according to a Guardian poll conducted ahead of the by-election <https://www.theguardian.com/politics/2026/jun/10/makerfield-byelection-voters-poll-social-media-posts-water-wealth-tax>
- So what for you: The Makerfield by-election outcome will directly shape Labour's internal power dynamics over the next 12 months, which could affect government stability and policy direction for your clients' B2B expansion plans into the UK market.

📰 Hacker News top 3
- Port React Compiler to Rust <https://github.com/react/react/pull/36173>
- European sentiments towards the US hit an all-time low <https://ecfr.eu/publication/home-alone-europeans-are-ready-to-defend-themselves/>
- AWS Bedrock to require sharing data with Anthropic for Mythos and future models <https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48473166>

Today's question: If your GTM advisory clients are now choosing Claude plus a spreadsheet over your Monday.com playbook, are you repositioning your pricing model to charge for outcome-based unit economics audits rather than tool-stack implementation, or are you betting that the market correction happens slowly enough for you to retrain while managing two kids and your sleep data?
